Examples:
    >>> from zvec.typing import Status, StatusCode
    >>> s = Status()
    >>> print(s.ok())
    True
    >>> s = Status(StatusCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT, "Field not found")
    >>> print(s.code() == StatusCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT)

    >>> print(s.message())
    Field not found
)pbdoc")
